g.text: Q1 / Q2: generic 30 V NMOS, pin order G = 1, D = 2, S = 3 (DPAK TO-252 pad order)

g.desc: Q1 / Q2: generic 30 V NMOS, pin order G = 1, D = 2, S = 3 (DPAK TO-252 pad order)

g.text: U1 UCC27211: VDD fed from VIN, C4 1 uF decoupling; R1 / R2 2.2 Ω gate resistors; R3 / R4 10k pulldowns

g.desc: U1 UCC27211: VDD fed from VIN, C4 1 uF decoupling; R1 / R2 2.2 Ω gate resistors; R3 / R4 10k pulldowns

g.text: Snubber SW -> R5 1.8 Ω -> SNB -> C6 1 nF C0G -> GND

g.desc: Snubber SW -> R5 1.8 Ω -> SNB -> C6 1 nF C0G -> GND

g.text: R6 shunt: 5 mΩ 1 %, 4-terminal Kelvin (force pins 1 / 4, sense pins 2 / 3)

g.desc: R6 shunt: 5 mΩ 1 %, 4-terminal Kelvin (force pins 1 / 4, sense pins 2 / 3)

g.text: U2 INA181A3 (gain 100 V/V), REF = GND, VS = +3V3: ISENSE = 100 x 15 mV = 1.5 V at 3 A
